Obby +1 Roll Ice Cream

Obby +1 Roll Ice Cream

About Obby +1 Roll Ice Cream

Push your scoop over the ice cream fields: every fresh tile rolls onto your giant ice cream roll. Run down the Sweet Road where each biome has a buyer who chases you down; the deeper they catch you, the more cash they pay for your roll. Buy better scoops, flavors and pets, rebirth and play online with others.

How to play

Move with WASD and look with the mouse Walk over the ice cream field to grow your roll then run north onto the Sweet Road When a buyer catches you press E to sell or watch a short video to decline and run deeper for a better price Press E at shops
